messages:
Luca: FYI I'm seeing a spike of TLS handshake failures across proxies in eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 starting ~03:20UTC. Errors: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` and some `handshake: EOF`.
Maya: Noted. Cert rotator ran last night — rotation succeeded in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 according to the rotator logs. ap-southeast-1 shows `rotate: success` but downstream proxies still failing.
Priya: Can you paste the proxy logs and the rotator logs? Also check KMS decrypt — rotator pulls private keys from KMS.
Luca: Attaching snippets (redacted). Example proxy error:
```
2026-03-18T03:21:12Z proxy-12 handshake error: remote error: tls: bad certificate
x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```
Rotator KMS error around the same time:
```
2026-03-18T03:19:58Z rotator eu-sg-rotator ERROR: kms.Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException
arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```
Maya: That AccessDenied lines up with a recent RBAC tidy-up — we scoped a couple of service account roles last week. Possible we removed `kms:Decrypt` for the rotator SA in ap-southeast.
KMS-Ops: Confirmed — policy change rolled 2026-03-17 21:10UTC to tighten cross-account decrypt. ap-southeast rotator SA wasn't on the allow list by mistake.
Sam: If rotator couldn't decrypt the private key, it could create a cert file with an incomplete chain or an empty key file which would produce `bad certificate` on the proxy. We should also check for intermediate chain being served.
Jules: Also check host time skew. There was a sporadic NTP drift incident last month in ap-southeast that caused validation to fail.
Priya: Quick triage plan:
- 03:40UTC: KMS-Ops add `kms:Decrypt` back to rotator SA in ap-southeast (temporary allow)
- 03:45UTC: Force rotator run for ap-southeast, verify key decrypt and certchain output
- 03:55UTC: Restart failing proxies with `graceful` so connections drain
- 04:10UTC: Verify audit logs show KMS decrypt events and cert validation OK
Can KMS-Ops confirm and ETA?
KMS-Ops: Adding decrypt permission now to `rotator-sa@ap-southeast-1`. ETA 5m. Also will check CloudTrail for `Decrypt` events and relay back.
Security-Bot: Incident alert created: INC-2026-0318-0042. Added priority P2. Assigned: Luca, Maya, KMS-Ops, Priya, Jules.
Luca: One more ask — audit logs for that window show no KMS:Decrypt attempts in ap-southeast, only in eu and us. If rotator tried and failed, I'd expect an explicit `Decrypt` entry. If none, maybe rotator used a cached key from another region and generated a mismatched certchain.
Maya: Good point. Could be cross-region replication race. We'll check rotator's region binding config. Also verify CA bundle includes intermediate `ACME-Int-2` — some proxies only have the leaf and not the intermediate.
Sam: If intermediate missing, we can temporarily enable TLS fallback profile that allows full chain enforcement lax -> but prefer fixing the chain quickly. Avoid downgrading TLS cipher suites.
Jules: After KMS fix, if proxies still fail, run `openssl s_client -connect proxy:443 -showcerts` from a node in-region to inspect presented chain.
Priya: Owners + actions:
- KMS-Ops: add permission, confirm CloudTrail, 03:45UTC
- Maya: force rotator run and capture rotator logs, 03:50UTC
- Jules: probe proxies and collect s_client outputs, 03:55UTC
- Luca: coordinate incident channel and notify customers if >30m degradation, 04:10UTC
Will update here when each step completes.
Luca: Update: KMS-Ops confirmed permissions added and we see a CloudTrail `Decrypt` at 03:41:07Z for rotator key in ap-southeast. Rotator log shows successful decrypt at 03:41:10Z and wrote new keyfile.
Maya: Forced rotator run completed, generated cert with full chain. Restarted proxies in ap-southeast via rolling restart. Initial checks show handshake errors cleared.
KMS-Ops: CloudTrail shows no further AccessDenied for the rotator in ap-southeast. We'll roll the temporary permission removal into a follow-up PR that explicitly allows rotator SA.
Priya: Follow-up actions for compliance/audit:
- Add explicit KMS allow statement for rotator service account in infra repo (PR + reviewers: KMS-Ops, Security)
- Add a unit test that validates rotator can decrypt in all target regions in CI
- Add an alert that fires when CloudTrail shows `AccessDenied` on KMS:Decrypt for rotator key
Luca: Thanks. Marking incident resolved in 53m. Will follow up with a postmortem draft covering RBAC change that caused the regression, missing intermediate chain checks, and adding the CI test.
Maya: Agree — include notes about not relaxing TLS hardening in emergency path and prefer certchain fixes. :thumbsup:
